download_aerialmegadepth_dataset: run the script to download the AerialMegaDepth dataset from HuggingFace to a target directory
download_archives: create a function that downloads dataset zip archives from a HuggingFace repo into a given directory
build_parser: build an argparse parser with target_dir and max_workers arguments for the AerialMegaDepth downloader
extract_and_move_npz: run the main function to download, extract zip archives, and move the aerial_megadepth_all.npz file
review_download_config: review the AerialMegaDepth download configuration constants including REPO_ID, ALLOW_PATTERNS, and DEFAULT_MAX_WORKERS
